mainstem waters within 3 white triangular fishing boundary signs located at the confluence of the Kispiox River with the Skeena River.

notes: SIGN-BOUNDED ZONE at the Kispiox confluence — the water within the triangular fishing boundary signs, not a reach between two landmarks. The page has carried this closure in THREE wordings (4 signs / 3 signs / three signs); they are ONE zone, curator-confirmed, see pipeline/docs/GOTCHAS.md. Bound as the 400 m above and below the confluence (https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=55.34260&mlon=-127.69129). THE 400 m IS AN ASSUMPTION — DFO gives no distance and 400 m is the radius it uses for the comparable Region 6 mouth closures. Caveat stays set until the signs are surveyed: the drawn reach is an estimate, so the app must show this wording and must not draw it as a plain fill.
